articles.title: REBNY gala celebrates resurgence despite political, economic uncertainties
articles.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani was notably absent from the Real Estate Board of New York's 130th annual gala held at the Waldorf-Astoria on Thursday. Although the specific reasons for his non-attendance are not detailed in the provided text, the report hints he was likely occupied with organizational tasks. His absence from such a significant industry event could be noteworthy within local political circles.

articles.title: Republic Day Parade 2026 Live: India to showcase military might and growth story at Republic Day 2026 parade
articles.summary: India celebrated its 77th Republic Day at Kartavya Path, New Delhi, with a grand spectacle showcasing the nation's journey of development, vibrant cultural diversity, and formidable military prowess. This display of national strength and unity serves as a powerful reminder of India's progress and capabilities, highlighting key aspects of national pride and defence preparedness vital for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Lanterns Aiming for "Sunday Night 9 O'clock HBO Show" Quality: King
articles.summary: The creators of the upcoming HBO/Max series 'Lanterns,' Tom King, Chris Mundy, and Damon Lindelof, are aiming for a high-quality standard. Starring Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler, the show is expected to delve into themes of intergalactic peacekeeping and defense, drawing from the Green Lantern Corps lore, promising a compelling viewing experience.

articles.title: 88-Year-Old Democrat Del. Eleanor Holmes Norton Terminates Campaign For 19th Term
articles.summary: US Representative Eleanor Holmes Norton, 88, of the District of Columbia, is ending her bid for a 19th term. Her decision comes months after a police report surfaced describing her, potentially impacting her long-standing political career. This marks the end of an era for the veteran Democratic delegate.

articles.title: Patriots punch Super Bowl ticket with win over Broncos
articles.summary: The New England Patriots are heading back to the Super Bowl, concluding a six-year wait. They secured their spot by winning the defensively-dominated AFC Championship Game. This achievement marks a significant moment in American football, generating considerable anticipation for the upcoming championship game, a widely followed international sports event.

articles.title: How ‘See You When I See You’ Director Jay Duplass Got Back Into Filmmaking After More Than a Decade Away
articles.summary: Filmmaker Jay Duplass's career significantly matured through the Sundance Film Festival. His initial three films, "The Puffy Chair," "Baghead," and "Cyrus," co-directed with his brother Mark Duplass, all premiered there. This collaboration and festival exposure were pivotal in shaping his development as a director, marking a key period in his cinematic journey within the industry.

articles.title: Chevron, oil execs send strong message on Venezuela
articles.summary: Venezuela holds the planet's largest oil reserves, estimated at 303 billion barrels. However, major international oil company executives are reportedly undecided about committing the billions of dollars necessary to revamp and modernize the country's oil infrastructure. This dilemma underscores significant economic and political complexities surrounding the utilization of Venezuela's vast energy resources.
